summary: Veru Inc. filed a Form 8-K on September 8, 2026 disclosing a strategic pipeline decision, not a transactional special situation. The company announced new positive preclinical data showing oral sabizabulin (IC50=18.2nM) overcame daraxonrasib resistance in KRAS-mutant metastatic pancreatic cancer cell lines, and will advance sabizabulin into a planned Phase 2 trial while discontinuing development for chronic inflammation related to atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease. The press release, attached as Exhibit 99.1, cites prior Phase 1b/2 data in 80 castration- and taxane-resistant prostate cancer subjects. No deal terms, advisors, or board recommendation were stated. Watch pipeline capital needs and dilution risk.
